During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] undertook a '''mission''' to rescue undercover operatives disguised as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in the territory of the Empire.
